Account background: NorthStar Trust (global custodian services for fintech and private banks). Heavy regulatory footprint (US/UK/EU). Evaluating Redwood Private VPC as primary inference platform for client-facing assistants and internal embeddings pipelines. Procurement + security intensive. POC started Nov 2025, expanded to security review Jan 2026.

Recent timeline / activity: 
- 2026-02-18 discovery + infra call (Fireflies ff_2026-02-18_nst_call). Covered network topology and initial log exporters.
- 2026-03-04 security deep-dive with InfoSec + SIEM owners (ff_2026-03-04_security_review). Demo of audit log samples.
- 2026-03-08 procurement sync: legal requested retention guarantees and third-party attestation.

Primary ask (audit logging / SIEM): 
- SIEM export to Splunk/Elastic/QRadar via secure forwarder (TLS). Prefer delivery through customer-managed S3 + KMS-encrypted objects for archival. Also want optional HTTP/JSON streaming endpoint for real-time ingest.
- Log schema: need consistent JSON schema across services: "event_type", "timestamp_iso", "request_id", "actor_id", "api_route", "model_id", "response_tokens_count", "latency_ms", "decision_flags", "data_residency_tag", "redaction_level". Want examples for chat generate, embeddings, rerank.
- Access logs: full API request metadata (headers subset, source CIDR, VPC endpoint id), but redact user PII before log emission; they require PII tokenization strategy and mapping doc.
- Retention: baseline 7 years for audit trail (per compliance), hot retention 90 days in SIEM, cold archive on encrypted S3 7+ years. Need ability to honor legal hold and selective purge.
- Ship frequency and volume: estimate 3M events/month across development and prod. Need batching/flush controls and backpressure behavior documented.

KMS / BYOK expectations: 
- Customer will bring CMK from AWS KMS (multi-account). Redwood must support envelope encryption where Redwood holds only ciphertext of logs; Redwood should never have raw CMK material.
- HSM-backed key policy review required. Need diagrams and sample IAM policies for S3 PutObject + KMS:Encrypt.

Security review notes / decision points: 
- InfoSec wants SIEM schema mapping spreadsheet (we to deliver) mapping Redwood log fields to NorthStar SIEM canonical fields (done: drive://redwood/security/northstar-siem-mapping.xlsx).
- Security asks for audit log integrity: signed log chunks (SHA256) and optional log forwarding over syslog-TLS.
- Legal needs written statement on scope of logs that contain customer data vs. system telemetry; we need to provide a retention & deletion playbook.
- Need explicit SLA for log export lag (acceptable: <120s near-real-time for streaming endpoint; daily batch within 4 hours for S3).

POC plan / acceptance criteria: 
- Week 1: deliver schema + sample payloads for chat/embeddings/rerank.
- Week 2: enable test forwarder to their Splunk dev instance; validate field mapping and redaction.
- Week 3: KMS BYOK proof-of-concept: show envelope encrypted artifacts in their S3 + successful re-decrypt using their CMK.
- Acceptance: SIEM ingests 10k events with correct fields, redaction validated, retention workflow tested.

Quotes / voice notes: "We cannot accept any plaintext customer PII in logs — must be redacted before it leaves our VPC, or else we fail audit." -- NorthStar CISO (summary).
